name: varHpOutdoorUnitProtectFunction
description:
This register shows the active protect functions, if active these protect functions may prevent the ODU running at the requested speed. When protect functions are active for too long the ODU may be switched off. 
Current protection: Active when current draw is too high, the maximum depends on the type of ODU.
TD protection: Active when the discharge temperature is too high, the maximum depends on the type of ODU.
TC protection: Active when the condenser temperature is too high, the maximum depends on the type of ODU.
